text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year. Praying for success in the 
Senior Class, I decided to go on a New 
Year shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's New Year's already, huh? Time 
really flies.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer, did you 
happen to watch it? Last month's Asahi Hai 
FS, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a GⅠ race that Biwa Hayahide once ran 
in. It's one of the races that decides the 
Junior Class champion, and...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard Narita Brian took 1st place in the 
same race the other day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Time really flies. I hear that child has 
already advanced to the Classic class.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...If it's early, it'll probably be this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide exhales as if making up her 
mind... and turns back to face me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—The stage where Brian and I shall 
compete.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's gather some intel on Brian right 
away. Her Classic year surely won't end 
with just the Triple Crown route.
choice_data_list: Is it so you can go beat Brian?
It's so we can go beat Brian, right

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the line is moving. Should we 
start getting ready to make our prayer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. What will you wish for this 
year?
choice_data_list: I hope Hayahide stays healthy and well.

I want to improve my abilities to grasp 
victory.

I want to hone my technique as much as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...A wish born out of concern for me, is 
it? You truly put Umamusume first in 
everything you do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let us have some amazake 
after we finish praying. We can savor the 
New Year while wishing for good health 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I savored the New Year together 
with Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is certainly an area where we 
both need to strive.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's head straight to training once we 
get back. All so we can make that wish of 
yours come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biwa Hayahide and I kicked off our 
training right from New Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, technique, is it? I believed the 
technique you were teaching was 
sufficient, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your ambition is truly something to learn 
from. ...I shall make the same wish as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent the New Year together with 
Biwa Hayahide.
